_about: F35: the Veteran's talking bubble (kit TalkingBubble, UI kit 0.31.0) — Muzzy's approved sketch S9 values (research/speaker-bubble/picks.json, 2026-10-23). Read every frame: Dev Kit edits show live.
_waveStart: Where the speech wave starts along the outline (0 = top-left corner, clockwise).
_readSec: F75: in a shift, his bubble never goes before its line has typed out and this many seconds more have passed (to read it) — so a slow frame can't cut him off mid-word (B009). Its own time (finalShift.json intro.lineSec, goneLineSec…) still counts from when it opens.
_waveEnd: Where it ends (0.34 = the first third). Start = end = all the way round.
_talkHeight: px: how tall the spikes get while he talks (and in a squelch).
_roundness: 0 = needle-sharp spikes · 5 = sine bumps · 10 = round bumps.
_variability: 0 = every spike the same width … 1 = very uneven.
_popSize: How much the outline swells on each syllable (0.025 = 2.5%). The words never move.
_pauseMs: ms of rest after . ! ? … (half after , and —).
_squelchEvery: Seconds between static squelches while he waits for you (± 1.5 s). 0 = never.
_colours: The bubble's colours (UI kit 0.33.0 TalkingBubble colours) — S9's light bubble with dark words (the sketch: fill #f4f4f2, words #222, outline #555 at 1.6 px, ▼ #888). Leave one out = the style's. Words that don't read on the fill (under 4.5 : 1) fall back to the style's.
